biography: Stephen Collins, a name now synonymous with calculated aggression on the track, hails from a small village in the Cotswolds, England. His introduction to motorsport was almost accidental. At 16, while working at his uncle's garage, he salvaged a wrecked Caterham Superlight, spending months rebuilding it in his spare time. The first time he took it to a local track day, he stunned everyone, including himself, with his natural talent and uncanny ability to read the track. His early career was marked by consistent podium finishes in local club racing, attracting the attention of Caterham Superlight's factory team. A defining moment came at the Brands Hatch round in 2018, where, despite starting last due to a qualifying mishap, he clawed his way to victory in a torrential downpour, showcasing his exceptional car control. Now at the peak of his career, Stephen is a force to be reckoned with, known for his relentless defense and unwavering focus.
drivingStyle: Collins' driving style is a masterclass in defensive racing. He prioritizes track position above all else, making his car incredibly wide and difficult to pass. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and masterful control in wet conditions. While not always the fastest in qualifying, he excels in race conditions, managing his tires meticulously and capitalizing on the mistakes of others. His ability to anticipate and react to the moves of his rivals is unparalleled, making him a formidable opponent in wheel-to-wheel combat.

rivalries.name: Marco Rossi
rivalries.reason: A fierce rivalry born from several on-track collisions and accusations of overly aggressive driving. Rossi and Collins have clashed numerous times, with their battles often ending in controversy.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A tactical rivalry. Dubois, known for her overtaking ability, often finds herself battling Collins, whose defensive style makes it incredibly hard to pass her.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A strategic rivalry, Tanaka's smooth and efficient driving style contrasts with Collins' defensive approach. Their differing approaches often lead to strategic battles on the track, with each trying to force the other into making a mistake.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue racing gloves, claiming they bring him luck.
Listens to classical music precisely 30 minutes before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to step on the racing line before the race starts, believing it will jinx his chances.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about speed; it's about control. Control of the car, control of your emotions, and control of your destiny."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brands Hatch round in 2018 from last place in torrential rain, showcasing his exceptional car control and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Silverstone race in 2020 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential championship victory.
